programme.title: Hooked on Africa
programme.desc: The Orange River is the largest and longest river in South Africa. It rises in the Moluti Mountains and flows through South Africa and the desert of Namibia before reaching the Atlantic Ocean. This river is home to diamonds, but it was the gold of both Small and Largemouth Yellowfish we were after.
